Notifications Calls, messages, mentions, replies, reactions and zaps — delivered even when the app is closed. 🔔 Enable push notifications Stay connected in the background Direct push normally reaches a closed PosterChan. This fallback keeps the client connection open on devices where push is unavailable, with the permanent notification Android requires, and starts again after a reboot. It uses more battery, so leave it off when push is working. Social is the timeline (picked below); anything else — Notes, Messages, Calendar… — opens that screen first instead. Syncs across your devices; a device that doesn't have the chosen screen falls back to the timeline. VIM KEYS h j k l to move, gg / G for top and bottom. h and l also cross between the nav rail, the feed and notifications. While on, l is movement, so React is f — Alt+L always works either way. Syncs across your devices. INSTANCE fixture.invalid ✓ poster.place Connect Use relays only (no server) Which PosterChan server this app talks to for AI, media rendering and streams — your Nostr key and your posts never depend on it, they live on relays. Tap a quick-pick or type a domain, or paste a .onion address to connect over Tor. Relays only runs the app with no server at all: you keep Social, Messages, Notes, Passwords, Budget and the games, and the server-backed features are hidden until you name an instance again. Switching reloads the app. NEWS SOURCES (ONE PER LINE: URL|NAME) — USED BY THE NEWS COMMAND Save settings
